“ Everyone has said that Iran cannot have nuclear weapons, but in the end, those are just words if you are not willing to take action when the time comes.”

Obama — sent Iran pallets of cash.

Biden — enriched Iran and told them, “don’t.”

Trump — crushing Iran militarily, neutralizing its ability to threaten America and the world.

‘NATO  has proven itself to be inconsequential. They don’t really matter here.’ - @VictoriaCoates

“ We can do devastating damage to a military like Iran’s, and all of their Chinese and all of their Russian equipment has been powerless against us.”

Video

.@VictoriaCoates joined Hannity immediately following President Trump’s address to the nation about Operation Epic Fury.

“[Operation Epic Fury] has been enormously successful by every possible metric. We’ll wrap it up in the next couple of weeks, and then we’ll see what happens to Iran after that. That’s entirely up to what’s left of the regime.”

Video

President Trump on the long-term effects of Operation Epic Fury: “ [Iran was] the bully of the Middle East, but they’re the bully no longer. This is a true investment in your children and your grandchildren’s future.”

Video

President Trump highlighted some of the worst attacks by Iran against Americans and U.S. allies over the last 47 years, saying that allowing the murderous regime to obtain nuclear weapons would be “an intolerable threat.”

“ The most violent and thuggish regime on earth would be free to carry out their campaigns of terror, coercion, conquest, and mass murder from behind a nuclear shield. I will never let that happen.”

Video

Highlighting the success of Operation Absolute Resolve, President Trump says the U.S. and Venezuela are now “joint venture partners,” in the production and sale of oil and gas, and that America is now “ totally independent of the Middle East” for oil.
